title: Shooting in Polish city of Krakow leaves 5 people dead and more than a dozen injured
summary: A shooter opened fire in a market square in the Polish city of Krakow on Saturday, leaving five people dead and more than a dozen injured, authorities said.

image.caption: A member of the Municipal Guard stands in an area near Krakow's Main Market Square after a shooting that killed five people and injured more than a dozen in the Polish city on Saturday. (Jakub Włodek/Reuters)

blocks.text: A shooter opened fire in a market square in the Polish city of Krakow on Saturday, leaving five people dead and more than a dozen injured, authorities said.
Shooting occurred in the Main Market Square, the municipal government said

The shooting occurred in the Main Market Square in Krakow, the municipal government said on social media platform X. A spokesperson for the local firefighters told Polsat News that the perpetrator fired a gun from a passing car.
Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk, in a post on X, said police are investigating the attack.
Other details were not immediately available.
Krakow, the second-largest city in Poland, is about 250 kilometres from the capital, Warsaw.
